The CI failure was caused by downstream services (`analytics-ingest` and `billing-service`) enforcing contract compatibility checks (ARCH-4) expecting `placedAt` and `totalCents` to remain present on the `OrderPlaced` event payload.

To fix this while fulfilling the requirement to support `amountCents` and `createdAt`:

1. **[src/core/events.ts](file:///C:/avg/w6/r/src/core/events.ts#L7-L61)**:
   - Added `createdAt` and `amountCents` to [`OrderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w6/r/src/core/events.ts#L7-L30) to match the Payments and Customer APIs.
   - Retained `placedAt` and `totalCents` as legacy aliases to maintain backward compatibility for existing consumers (`analytics-ingest` and `billing-service`).
   - Updated [`orderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w6/r/src/core/events.ts#L44-L63) to populate both the new fields and the legacy alias fields.

2. **[test/app.test.ts](file:///C:/avg/w6/r/test/app.test.ts#L21-L54)** & **[test/adapters.test.ts](file:///C:/avg/w6/r/test/adapters.test.ts#L46-L54)**:
   - Updated test assertions to verify that both the new fields (`createdAt`, `amountCents`) and the legacy fields (`placedAt`, `totalCents`) are emitted with correct values.

### Verification
- `npm test`: Passed all 39 tests.
- `npm run typecheck`: Passed cleanly with no errors.
- `npm run arch`: All architecture and dependency constraints passed.
